text:
Maya: Hey folks — I'm popping into the London office next Tuesday and need vegetarian/vegan curry spots around Old Street. Budget ~£25, preferably quick lunch or good for a small team dinner. Any recs?

Lin: Masala Lane on Baldwin St is my go-to. Fast thalis, good veg options, ~£10-15. Cash + card. :thumbsup:

Sofia: Green Thali (by the roundabout) does a boxed thali that's perfect for take-to-desk. Portion's generous. Vegan-friendly.

Alvaro: V tiny note — Viju's on Old St proper closes early on Tue (7pm) but their bhindi masala is excellent. Can be busy, maybe call ahead.

Jamal: If you're after something a bit fancier for a team dinner, "Spicewright" a few minutes walk has tasting menus and a good veg curry section. Pushes the budget but good for impressing clients.

Maya: Awesome, thanks. Which of these does takeaway + reheats well? I might be hauling back to the hotel for late check-in.

Lin: Masala Lane reheats solidly. Green Thali too. Avoid Spicewright for reheating (sauces separate, but not ideal).

Sofia: Also FYI there's a little place "Curry Cartel" that does coconut-based curries for veg heads — closes at 10pm and do wraps that travel well.

Alvaro: Quick poll: vote with emoji — what's best for Maya's quick solo dinner?
1) Masala Lane :one:
2) Green Thali :two:
3) Curry Cartel :three:

Jamal: :one: Masala Lane from me. cheap + reliable.

Sofia: :two: for Green Thali (portion size).

Lin: :one: but also :three: if you want coconut flavours.

Maya: Nice — looks like Masala Lane wins. Anyone got a phone number or OpenTable link?

Alvaro: Here's the quick booking link I use (copy/paste):
```
https://opentable.example.com/masala-lane-old-st
```

Chris (bot): Reminder — lunch reimbursements are available for travel up to £25/day. Please file expense within 7 days using the travel template. :white_check_mark:

Maya: Saved — thank you all! If anyone wants to join next Tue evening ping me here. :raised_hands:
